text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun is helping me organize
some
documents, when...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Look! City's in this magazine!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She's so pretty. ♪ That outfit shows so
much skin,
and she's rocking it!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wait, I just got the best idea!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After we finish organizing, we head out
for a
walk.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Oh. Hey, Mayano.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hello!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Yuki! City! Perfect timing! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: You're a model, aren't you, City?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
You must know a lot of grown-up
models since
you're a cool grown-up
yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So please tell me the secret to becoming
a mature
woman! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
A "mature woman," huh? You're
obsessed with
that idea, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: A "mature woman"?! G-golly gee!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...But come t'think of it... I'd like to hear
the
secret to becom'n a city girl too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whaaat... You too, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Fine. I'll tell you what I know, but how
you take it
is up to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to being a model, there
are two
things you have to keep in mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: First is your condition.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
In other words, you must always be the
best
version of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The best version of myself... Cool! And
the next
one?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Second is speed.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You must have an antenna trained on
new trends
so you can always be at the
forefront.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: R-roger dodger!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
That explains why you're always so
twinkly, City!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So if I can do the same, I can grow up at
Mach 10!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So if I can do the same, I can grow up at
Mach 10!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Exactly! ♪ Good condition!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Good condition means... I've got to get
stronger,
right? Okay, I think I know
what to do!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
I just need to up my stamina! Right,
Trainer? ♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, let's go! Blink, and you might
miss me
growing up! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's not what I meant, but... I guess it's
fine.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She'll grow up in a way only she can, I
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You're so cool! Makes me wanna be just
like you
too, City!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In order to be the best version of
herself, Mayano
Top Gun doubles down
on her training and
manages to increase
her stamina.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Exactly! ♪ My speed!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
And when it comes to speed... I've got
just the
thing!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
A pacer test! I'm pretty sure one of my
teachers
mentioned it before.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then it's decided! ♪ Especially since it's
got your
seal of approval, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Preparing for takeoff! ☆ I'll be the
fastest ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City... Um, I'm also itchin' t'be a city girl!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see. In that case, don't concern yourself
with
me... Just do your best.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Gotcha! Watch me jam!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun begins her pacer test
training to
increase her speed. It ends up
being quite
effective.
